summary.lead: FOMC day, with two other storms already on the tape.
summary.body: The Fed's decision lands at 2:00 PM ET with Chair Kevin Warsh's press conference at 2:30 PM, and it is a genuinely close call: CME FedWatch odds of a hold have slipped to roughly 64-70%, down from over 80% a week ago. The reason is oil, again. Layered on top is a second, unrelated shock: an AI capex semiconductor rout out of Asia.
